https://iili.io/2Seh8UQ.gif

A century ago, the Lunar War erupted over the contested Lagh Metal meteorite that had fallen on the Moon. During the conflict, TALON (Tactical Aviation Low Orbit Network) commanded over a thousand air battles. The deep neural network formed by intercommunicating orbital fighter squadrons quickly surpassed human tactical ingenuity, demonstrating foresight far beyond even the greatest strategists.

notes.title: Update 0.4.9 and Closed Beta Progress Report
notes.notes:
Issues to Address During the Rebuilding

Thank you for taking part in the closed beta and providing valuable feedback! Before entering phase 2, a series of rebuilding and optimization work needs to be done to rectify the following issues detected in the first phase of closed beta:

Horrendous performance for mid-tier PCs / Futureproofing
The biggest issue in terms of time. Hard to say exactly how it'll affect things but potentially a delay to current plans to improve basic stability, optimization, and server handling. Pinpoint timeframe inexact, but estimated 2 months at least. We don't like delays, but we feel it's ultimately necessary. We will still add new contents and updates to the current framework before the reconstructing is complete.

VR functionality
Updated version is in development and not implemented, the team wasn't happy with how it was before. We aim to add real time physics-based touch interactions between player and the avatar in the VR mode and allow desktop and VR players to share the same room.
Will still happen in Phase 2. Should be improved by the above point as well.

Current in-game mechanics
Game is too grindy. The team is working on ways to improve this by adding interplayer interactions, environment device/bondage mechanisms and combat drill mode, effectively triple the in-game resource gain and make the Harem mode more fun to take part in. Your feedback's been heard and is on the table for serious consideration as the rebuild goes on.
New Contents Added During Rebuilding

Combat Drill Mode
In Combat drill mode the player commands the cyberdolls to fight in simulated battles against cultists and eldritch horrors to earn Intel.
Spending Intel when analyzing a blueprint will guarantee that the yielded experiments are not duplicated.

Bondage Mechanism
A player can restrain their avatar on one of the environment devices, such as glory hole, kabeshiri or obstetrical table. The investigators will stay restrained until Sanity runs out, even if their owner went offline. Unique sexual interactions can happen if other players decide to have fun with the bondaged investigators, depending on the location where they are placed.

The offline player can retrieve the Likes and Inspirations collected during the process the next time they log in Harem Mode.
